title: Diana Pasulka's research in the files of St. Joseph of Cupertino
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Diana Pasulka's research in the files of St. Joseph of Cupertino, about 17th century at Italy, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I have a friend named Diana Pasulka, who's a religious studies professor at UNC Wilmington. She's gone very deep on St. Joseph of of Cupertino and she has gone through a lot of his files and she agrees with that.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a friend of his, Diana Pasulka, a religious studies professor at the University of North Carolina Wilmington, has gone very deep on St. Joseph of Cupertino, a saint from seventeenth-century Italy. According to Michels, she has gone through many of the saint's files and agrees with the point he was making, which, if right, would let old church records back up his argument.
